The Solar System

The solar system consists of the Sun at the centre and eight planets orbiting around it. The planets are Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Each planet has unique characteristics in terms of size, composition, and distance from the Sun. The Earth is the third planet from the Sun and is the only known planet to support life. The atmosphere of Earth contains nitrogen, oxygen, and other gases that are essential for sustaining life. The solar system also contains other celestial bodies such as asteroids, comets, and meteoroids, which are smaller objects that orbit the Sun or planets.
